evidence.excerpt: Mamužić is co-supervising two PhD students expected to defend in 2026–2027, which limits availability for new PhD co-supervision until 2027. She is particularly interested in collaboration with companies that manufacture or integrate variable-speed drives, frequency converters, or industrial automation equipment and face IEC 61800-3 compliance challenges. Access to the Faculty's EMI test receiver and LISN setup can be arranged for collaborative projects under a formal agreement.
